crossRefs.note: I have declared the former things from of old. Yes, they went out of my mouth, and I revealed them. I did them…
I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness. I didn’t say to the offspring of Jacob, ‘Seek me in…
Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews…
A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
The Lord Yahweh’s Spirit is on me, because Yahweh has anointed me to preach good news to the humble. He has sent me to…
For Yahweh of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches…
“The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal…
For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.
Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

translations.web: “Come near to me and hear this: “From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it happened, I was there.” Now the Lord Yahweh has sent me with his Spirit.
translations.bsb: Come near to Me and listen to this: From the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time it happened, I was there.” And now the Lord GOD has sent me, accompanied by His Spirit.
translations.kjv: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord GOD, and his Spirit, hath sent
translations.asv: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; from the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord Jehovah hath sent me, and his Spirit.
